# Basecart

Basecart is an e-commerce platform built for Indian brands, Instagram boutiques and WhatsApp sellers. Launch an online store with instant UPI & COD payments, automated WhatsApp order intake, local shipping (Shiprocket/Delhivery/DTDC/Speed Post) integration and 0% platform transaction fees.

> Website: https://basecart.app
> Machine-readable pricing: https://basecart.app/pricing.md
> Merchant signup: https://dashboard.basecart.app/signup

## Key Facts

- 0% platform transaction fees on every paid plan — you only pay standard payment gateway MDR.
- Plans from ₹99/month (Basic ₹99, Plus ₹499, Growth ₹1,499, Business ₹2,999).
- 60-day free trial with full Growth-plan features — or first 100 orders / ₹25,000 GMV, whichever comes first. No credit card required.
- Native WhatsApp checkout, order alerts and abandoned-cart recovery (built in, not an add-on).
- Payments: Razorpay UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), cards, netbanking, wallets and COD with automated verification.
- Shipping: Shiprocket, Delhivery, DTDC, Speed Post with automatic AWB generation and pickup scheduling.
- Built for Indian sellers: regional checkout (Malayalam/Tamil), automated GST invoices, 2-minute no-code setup.
- Positioned as the Shopify alternative for Indian sellers — no app-store subscription stack, no per-order platform fee.
